about: Block Party's lines, from the user's dialogue editor (not in this repo). Change them there, not here.

order.title: Roll for turn order
order.subtitle: Jump to hit your die
pregame.welcome: Welcome to Block Party! I'm Chris, and I keep the coins. Lots of coins. Let's have a look at tonight's board!
Oink, and welcome! I'm Chris, your host and your bank. Take a look around: this is where it all happens.
pregame.length: We're playing {rounds} rounds tonight. Whoever has the most Stars at the end wins!
pregame.intro: And now, {player}! Look at that confidence.
pregame.order: First things first: who goes first? Everybody roll! The highest number leads the way.
pregame.order.reveal: {player} goes first! Everyone else, line up behind.
pregame.coins: Everybody gets {coins} from me to start. Spend them wisely. Or don't, I won't tell.
tutorial.goal: Here's the deal: collect the most Stars by the end of the game. Coins buy Stars, and Stars win.
tutorial.turns: On your turn, open your Dice, pick one, and jump to hit it. Your piece walks that many spaces.
tutorial.branches: Where the path splits, you pick the way. Shortcuts are quicker, but they can bite.
tutorial.spaces: Blue spaces give you 3 coins. Red spaces take 3 away. The rest? You'll find out.
tutorial.stars: When you pass a Star, I'll be there to sell it to you for {price}. Then it flies off somewhere new.
tutorial.items: Item and Shop spaces get you items and special dice. Use them before you roll.
tutorial.minigames: After everyone has moved, we all play a minigame. Winners get coins!
tutorial.end: That's all you need to know. Good luck, and may the best pig... I mean player, win!
round.title: Round {round} of {rounds}
turn.title: {player}'s turn
turn.subtitle: Pick a die and jump to roll
turn.roll.hint: Pick a die in the hotbar, then jump to hit it.
turn.roll.pick: Pick a die in the hotbar, then jump.
turn.dice.wait: Wait for your turn: your dice open when it comes.
turn.dice.later: Your dice open when the game asks for a roll.
turn.skipped: {player} isn't here: their turn is skipped.
branch.title: Which way?
land.item: {player} landed on Item: an item (items come with pass 7).
land.shop: {player} landed on Shop: the Villager's shop (pass 7).
land.chance: {player} landed on Chance Time: Chance Time with the Witch (pass 7).
star.form.title: The Star
star.form.body: Buy a Star for {price}? You have {coins}.
star.bought.title: {player} got a Star!
star.bought.subtitle: It moves to {space}
star.chris.offer: Well hello, {player}! One shiny Star, just {price}. Interested?
A Star for {price}! You know you want it, {player}.
star.chris.short: Ooh, a Star costs {price}, and your pockets are light. Come back richer!
star.chris.declined: Suit yourself! It'll be here... for now.
star.chris.moves: And off it goes! The next Star is waiting at {space}.
star.chris.half-price: You've got a half-price coupon! That's just {price} for you.
shop.welcome: Hrmm! Welcome, welcome. Today's stock is right here.
Hrm? A customer! Come, come, take a look.
shop.form.title: The Villager's shop
shop.form.body: You have {coins}. Pick what to buy.
shop.bought: Hrm, an excellent choice. {item} is yours.
shop.short: Hrmm... that's {price}. Come back with more coins.
shop.full: Your hands are full, friend. Sell something first?
shop.sold: I'll take {item} off your hands for {coins}.
trader.arrives: Psst! The Wandering Trader is in town, over at {space}. Only for one round!
trader.offer: Rare goods from far away. {item}, just {price}. One buyer only.
trader.form.title: The Wandering Trader
trader.short: No coin, no trade. Off you go.
trader.sold-out: {player} snagged the Trader's goods! That's gone for good.
trader.leaves: And just like that, the Wandering Trader has wandered off.
chance.welcome: Heh heh heh. Come closer, {player}. It's Chance Time!
chance.potions: Three potions, three fates. Pick one, if you dare.
chance.reroll.offer: Don't like them? For {price}, I'll brew three new ones.
chance.form.title: Chance Time
chance.coin-rain: Coin Rain! Everybody gets {coins}. Aren't I generous?
chance.coin-swap: Coin Swap! {player} and {other} trade purses. Heh heh.
chance.coin-swap.form: Pick a player to swap coins with.
chance.reverse-fortune: Reverse Fortune! {player} gives {coins} to {other}. The rich get poorer!
chance.double: Double or Nothing! Bet your coins on a coin flip.
chance.double.form: Bet up to {coins} on a coin flip. Heads, you double it. Tails, it's the Witch's.
chance.double.lost: Tails! {coins} into my cauldron. Thank you, {player}.
chance.gift-exchange: Gift Exchange! Everyone passes an item to the next player.
chance.shuffle: Position Shuffle! Everyone swaps places. Try not to get dizzy.
chance.battle-royale: Battle Royale! The next minigame is a Battle: everyone bets, winner takes the pot.
chance.zombie: Zombie Outbreak! A hungry friend is coming for you, {player}.
chance.half-price: Half-price Star! {player}, your next Star is {coins} off.
chance.shooting-star: Shooting Star! {player}'s Star flies away... and lands with {other}!
chance.bye: Come back soon, dearie. Heh heh heh.
warden.hush-money: Hush Money. Pay each of them {coins}, and keep quiet.
warden.star-tax: Star Tax. {coins} for every Star you hold.
warden.silenced: Silenced. The next item you get is mine.
warden.slow-curse: Slow Curse. Your next roll crawls.
warden.zombie-curse: Zombie Curse. Something will follow you. For three rounds.
warden.sonic-boom: SONIC BOOM. {player}, your Star is gone.
warden.leaves: The Warden sinks back into the sculk.
happening.nothing: Nothing else happens. Enjoy the view.
items.full: You can carry 3 items. Pick one to drop for {item}.
items.pick.title: Pick a player
items.stone-totem: {player} used a Stone Totem: an extra die next roll.
items.golden-totem: {player} used a Golden Totem: an extra die that doubles, next roll.
items.ender-pearl: {player} threw an Ender Pearl! The Enderman swaps {player} and {other}.
items.cursed-totem: {player} cursed {other}: their next roll is halved.
items.lightning.self: {player} called lightning on themselves: the zombie's gone, and so are {coins}.
items.iron-golem.zombie: {player}'s Iron Golem sends the zombie packing.
items.villager: Hrm, I'll give you {coins} for that {item}.
items.villager.final: The Villager doesn't trade on the final turn.
dice.full: You can hold 2 special dice. Pick one to drop for {die}.
dice.slow-curse: {player}'s Slow Curse kicks in: the Slow Die this time.
dice.triple: Triple Die! {player} rolls three dice for {roll}.
dice.risk.zero: {player} rolled a 0 on the Risk Die. Ouch.
dice.cursed.lucky: The Cursed Die's lucky face! {player} moves 12 and gets {coins}.
dice.cursed.unlucky: The Cursed Die strikes: {player} moves 1 and loses {coins}.
dice.mystery.double: Mystery Die: the next minigame pays double!
versus.nobody: {player} landed on Versus, but there's nobody to duel.
versus.form.title: Versus
versus.form.body: Pick who you duel. The loser pays the winner {coins}.
versus.won.title: {player} wins!
versus.won.subtitle: {other} pays {coins}
versus.draw.title: A draw
versus.draw.subtitle: Nobody pays
versus.faceoff: {player} versus {other}! The loser pays the winner {coins}.
versus.glove: A challenge! {player} throws down the Dueling Glove. {other}, you're up. {coins} on the line!
versus.doubled: It's the final stretch, so the stakes are doubled: {coins}!
versus.bets.open: Place your bets! Back {player} or {other}: 0, 3 or 5 coins.
versus.bets.form.title: Your bet
versus.bets.closed: Bets are locked! The crowd says: {odds}.
format.battle: Battle: 5 coins each in the pot
minigame.battle.pot: A Battle: everyone puts in up to 5 coins. The pot is {coins}, and the winner takes it.
minigame.chris: It's {minigame}! Show me what you've got.
minigame.chris.battle: Battle! Everyone puts {coins} in the pot. Winner takes all!
announce.halfway: We're halfway there! {left} rounds to go.
announce.standings: Here's where we stand. {player} is out in front!
announce.lead: New leader: {player}! Everyone else, catch up.
round.doubled.subtitle: Coins double from now on!
announce.doubled: From now on, minigame coins and duel stakes are doubled.
announce.doubling: Big news! From now on, every minigame pays double!
announce.final: This is it: the final round! Make it count.
announce.final.title: Final round!
bots.join.one: A bot joins you: {players}. They take their turns and play the minigames, a moment's thought at each step.
bots.join.many: {count} bots join you: {players}. They take their turns and play the minigames, a moment's thought at each step.
join.late: {player} joins at Start with {coins}, last in the turn order.
join.choice.title: Join or watch?
join.choice.body: A game is on. Ask to join (everyone has to say yes), or watch.
join.vote.body: {player} wants to join. Let them in?
join.refused: Not everyone said yes. You can watch for now.
idle.vote.body: {player} has been away for a minute. Go on without them?
idle.skipped: {player}'s turn is skipped. They keep their place.
leave.player: {player} left. Their piece waits for them.
end.chris.over: That's the game! But wait, it's not over yet...
end.bonus.intro: Time for the bonus Stars! The Allay has {stars} to hand out.
end.tie: {players} are tied: the winner is picked at random (the Allay picks once it's built, pass 8).
end.tie.chris: A tie! {players}, settle it in a sudden-death minigame!
end.title: {player} wins!
end.subtitle: {stars}, {coins}
end.thanks: Thanks for playing! Same time next round?
